sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 234346 (catx.py: 53 sites)

values.note: Peak season (Memorial Day weekend - Labor Day): single site $20/night including 2 vehicles, additional vehicle $5/night, group sites A/B $50/night. Off-season the campground is 'partially open to free camping', snow dependent (fees charged until 2026-09-08). Off-season FCFS sites are paid by scanning a QR code with the Recreation.gov app.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/big-larch-campground ('Peak Season (Memorial Day weekend - Labor Day): Single Site: $20 per night (2 vehicles included/site)'; 'Fees charged until 9/8/2026, partially open to free camping in off-season, snow dependent.') + recreation.gov /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-07 and 2027-05-28 to 2027-09-06: individual sites $20, group $50), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234346 (notice: 'No utility hookups are available.') + catalog (all 53 sites STANDARD/GROUP NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 29 reservable individual RV/tent sites plus 19 first-come individual sites (48), two group areas and three bicycle (tent) sites. Rec.gov lists equipment lengths of 20-51 ft; about 20 sites take 23 ft or more.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/big-larch-campground ('29 individual RV/tent campsites ... Nineteen individual sites are available on a First-Come/First-Serve basis') + recreation.gov campsite search (max vehicle length 20-51 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water in peak season only (rec.gov 'Drinking Water (peak season)'). Campground host, paved roads, roped-off swimming beach, boat ramp and dock, trash and recycling.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/big-larch-campground ('Accessible vault toilets, drinking water and trash receptacles are available throughout the campground', 'Potable water is available at this site.') + rec.gov amenities ('Drinking Water (peak season)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Loops 1 and 4 and the group sites are open year-round, snow load determining access (intermittent plowing, entrance to boat launch only); Loops 2 and 3 open the Friday before Memorial Day through Labor Day. Call 406-677-2233 about the off-peak season.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/big-larch-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Loop 1: Open Year-Round : Snow Load Determines Accessibility ... Loop 2: Open dates for this loop are the Friday before Memorial Day through Labor Day ... Loop 4: Open Year-Round'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 29 individual sites, 2 group areas and 3 bike sites are reservable from the Friday before Memorial Day to Labor Day and become first-come outside those dates; 19 individual sites are always first-come (pay by QR code in the Recreation.gov app). Rec.gov: 16 consecutive nights, 32 nights a year.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/big-larch-campground (Reservations section) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234346 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 days each year), read 2026-10-22

note: Lolo NF (Seeley Lake RD) on the east shore of Seeley Lake, 1 mile north of town on MT-83; larch and pine forest with little understory (roomy but not private), swimming beach, boat launch and dock. --Claude
summary: FS page (Sept 2026) and rec.gov: confirmed $20 peak, rec.gov booking, no hookups, vault toilets, water, phone 406-677-2233. Changed fees low 20->0 (free off-season camping), season opens 05-28 -> year-round (Loops 1/4 and group sites; Loops 2/3 Memorial-Labor Day), fcfs after_cutoff -> some_sites (19 always-FCFS sites). Added 48 sites, 51-ft max, 16-night limit, sewer false. Forest Service-run (Seeley Lake RD); no closure order for it. Note trimmed.
